name: Drops, pickup, mesos and inventory rules

drop_timing.statement: loot drops as soon as the mob dies.
drop_timing.note: Monster page (Snail). The death animation length is per-monster data (Snail: body fades over 1.26 s).

pickup_lines: x: 25 px left to 25 px right
y: 60 px above to 30 px below
pickup_key_note: Items you pick up will be automatically stored in the appropriate tab.
inventory_full: When your Item Inventory is full, you won't be able to pick up new items.

ownership.statement: Pets follow your ownership rules. They take free drops and drops that belong to you or your party.
ownership.party_loot_definition: Whether item drops go free-for-all or rotate by party member.

drop_tables.statement: Classic World appears to draw from the pre-Big-Bang MapleSEA drop tables. This list is historical reference only and shows what this monster dropped in old MapleSEA.
drop_tables.community: Items players have personally seen drop in-game. Upvote what you've seen, downvote what you haven't.
drop_tables.note: Per-monster drop lists (community-confirmed and MSEA reference) are monsters/drops domain data. MeowDB gives no drop chances.

mesos.note: Monster pages show "Mesos per kill" from player reports (/msclassic/api/mesos-reports?monsterId=...), monsters domain. No meso-drop formula is published.

gaps: Drop expiry time (how long an item/meso stays on the ground) is not documented.
Drop ownership duration (how long a drop belongs to the killer before becoming free-for-all) is not documented.
Meso drop amount formula and item drop chances are not documented.
Drop scatter pattern (spacing between multiple drops) is not documented.
